title: Storage Encryption and Security
description: Secure Azure Storage with encryption, SAS tokens, private endpoints, and firewall rules.

data.text: Your storage account contains sensitive customer data. You need to encrypt data at rest and in transit, restrict access to specific VNets, and generate time-limited access tokens for mobile clients. How do you secure it?

Enable **encryption at rest** (Microsoft-managed keys by default). Use **SAS tokens** for time-limited client access. Configure **private endpoints** for VNet-only access. Enable **firewall rules** to restrict public access.

data.title: Azure CLI - Secure Storage Account
data.code:
# Enable secure transfer required
az storage account update \
  --name 'mystorage' \
  --resource-group 'rg-storage' \
  --https-only true

# Create private endpoint
az network private-endpoint create \
  --name 'pe-storage' \
  --resource-group 'rg-storage' \
  --vnet-name 'vnet-prod' \
  --subnet 'subnet-private' \
  --private-connection-resource-id '/subscriptions/.../storageAccounts/mystorage' \
  --group-id 'blob'

# Generate SAS token (C#)
var sas = new BlobSasBuilder
{
    BlobContainerName = "uploads",
    BlobName = "document.pdf",
    ExpiresOn = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddHours(1)
};
sas.SetPermissions(BlobSasPermissions.Read | BlobSasPermissions.Create);

data.text: Azure Storage provides **defense in depth**: encryption protects data, private endpoints hide it from the public internet, and SAS tokens give granular, time-limited access. This meets most compliance requirements (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA).
